title: Theme adapter
description: A design system's character expressed as values for the semantic contract, plus its capability declaration. Adapters are read-only portraits of their source (docs/LINKING.md R3).

sourceRef.description: <repo>@<version|commit> — which sitting this portrait was painted from

contract.description: semver of the contract this adapter conforms to

constraints.description: What this theme does NOT permit — visible, never hidden

tokens.description: Values for the contract slots, by mode and category

variantMaps.description: Canonical axis cells -> this system's variant names, plus declared fallbacks

anatomySpecific.description: Components whose structure exists only in this system
